description:
A top-up (POST /v1/account/topups 201, GET /v1/account/topups/{topup_id}).

`amount_usd_micro` is the credit asked for (tax, if any, is on top at checkout).
`checkout_url` is the Stripe-hosted Checkout page (null if auth could not open
one); the balance is credited only when auth has verified the payment, and then
`status` is `credited` and `credited_at` is set. An abandoned Checkout ends
`expired`.

refused: paid, never credited, refunded in full because the billing-address or
card country is sanctioned. Terminal.
title: TopupOut
